body: Have you enabled cache? I think it could resolve the problem.

I’ve set the redis based caches:

https://docs.gitea.io/en-us/config-cheat-sheet/#cache-cache
https://docs.gitea.io/en-us/config-cheat-sheet/#cache---lastcommitcache-settings-cachelast_commit

Excerpt from config:
```
[cache]
ENABLED = true
ADAPTER = redis
HOST    = rediss+sentinel://<redacted>
[cache.last_commit]
ENABLED = true
```

Is there any Cache config that needs to be set manually?
I see the feature mentions caching but it does indeed not look like it is being utilized for this query.
Looks like `memory` cache fix the problem. I will take a look.

issue.body:
Fix #22281

In #21621 , `Get[V]` and `Set[V]` has been introduced, so that cache value will be `*Setting`. For memory cache it's OK. But for redis cache, it can only store `string` for the current implementation. This PR revert some of changes of that and just store or return a `string` for system setting.
